decisions.reason: The brochure quantity is a separate clause already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; changing the portfolio count requires no additional brochure-state change.
The portfolio-count change does not alter the independently defined business-pitch content or image requirement.
The deliverable quantities do not change the aircraft-tailored visual treatment, reference basis, text density, or visual-impact direction.
Social-media content is independently introduced by another clause in the same message; the portfolio-count change does not modify its quantity or scope.
